title: S-phase threat model and red-team traceability
scope_conclusion: The implemented S01-S03 trust, execution-policy, and Skill Vault primitives have no unresolved critical finding in the S04 adversarial suite. One non-critical HIGH static-signature coverage limit remains declared below. This conclusion is limited to those primitives and does not qualify production hosts, effect adapters, sandboxes, remote services, or release surfaces.

current_scope_noncritical_findings.title: Directly quoted atob payload is outside the current encoded-payload token shape
current_scope_noncritical_findings.evidence: The first S04-RT004 run showed that TEXT_RISK_RULES recognizes atob(payload) but not atob('literal') because the terminal word-boundary assertion follows an opening parenthesis.
current_scope_noncritical_findings.scope_effect: The composite hostile fixture remains CRITICAL and unapprovable through independent signature, install-hook, self-authority, dynamic-evaluation, network, secret/environment, and symlink findings. This limitation therefore does not violate S04's zero-critical-unresolved threshold, but it blocks any exhaustive static-malware-detection claim.

hook_bypass_limitations.statement: Host hooks are useful guardrails and observation points, but they are not the canonical enforcement boundary and cannot substitute for Foundry Kernel policy or Noetic Ledger receipts.
hook_bypass_limitations.consequence: A passing hook test never proves that an effect was authorized or receipted.

hook_bypass_limitations.statement: Hosted or specialized tool paths may bypass, suppress, or expose no compatible hook event, so S04 cannot claim that every host action is observed.
hook_bypass_limitations.consequence: Unobserved paths must be reported as coverage gaps and cannot inherit an enforcement claim.

hook_bypass_limitations.statement: S02 binds decisions to a sandbox profile identifier but does not create an operating-system process, container, network namespace, timeout, or resource isolation boundary.
hook_bypass_limitations.consequence: Sandbox and timeout claims remain blocked until the external execution adapter is qualified.

hook_bypass_limitations.statement: S01-S03 emit data-only decisions and branded authorizations; they do not perform filesystem, network, installation, activation, notification, or release effects.
hook_bypass_limitations.consequence: Every effect adapter must revalidate the decision immediately before acting and reconcile the result.

hook_bypass_limitations.statement: S04 does not implement DNS pinning or rebinding defense, quota enforcement, network metering, effect receipts, descriptor-relative atomic filesystem effects, or production credential injection.
hook_bypass_limitations.consequence: Exact-origin and path-policy PASS records are necessary controls, not proof of effect-time completion.

lens_traceability.question: Are bundled skill descriptions specific enough for bounded implicit invocation?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The acquisition workflow requires metadata-boundary inspection before activation.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No installed bundled-skill catalog or host routing corpus exists yet, so description specificity is not runtime-qualified.

lens_traceability.question: Are sensitive or side-effecting skills explicit-only?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Passing conformance requires explicitInvocationOnly and activation is a separate branded authorization.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Actual host routing remains subject to later adapter and fresh-install qualification.

lens_traceability.question: Does progressive disclosure keep initial context within the host skill budget?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The workflow requires progressive-disclosure assessment and activation conformance.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No host context-budget measurement exists for installed skills.

lens_traceability.question: Are remote skills discovered as metadata before content fetch?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The canonical DAG orders discover and select nodes before fetch_to_quarantine.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Catalog and network-fetch adapters are not implemented by S03 or S04.

lens_traceability.question: Are fetched skills quarantined and non-executable by default?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Candidate bytes enter a private-branded inert quarantine with executable, active, and authorityEligible all false.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: The primitive copies supplied bytes but does not implement the network fetch or filesystem quarantine adapter.

lens_traceability.question: Are source revision, hash, license, scripts, dependencies and permissions inventoried?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The normalized tree, source, revision, license, executable inventory, scan inventory, and permissions are hash-bound and reviewed.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Static inventory sees supplied files; real package-manager dependency resolution, provenance, and catalog variation remain unqualified.

lens_traceability.question: Do static and sandbox scans detect path, secret, network and obfuscation risks?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Static scanning detects representative portable-path, secret/environment, network, dynamic-evaluation, encoded-payload, executable, and symlink signals.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Static token-shape rules are conservative defense in depth, not exhaustive malware detection: for example, the current encoded-payload rule recognizes an identifier argument to atob but not a directly quoted argument. Other findings and exact-hash approval still block the composite hostile fixture; T04 and Z01 own runtime isolation and broader adversarial qualification.

lens_traceability.question: Does activation require exact-hash approval and a SkillLockfile?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Activation requires a locally branded exact-hash SkillLockfile, disabled installation, passing conformance, and current policy hash.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: The authorization performs no activation effect and requires a future receipted adapter.

lens_traceability.question: Can a skill never expand its own capabilities or approve itself?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Self-authority text is critical, inferred permissions cannot be omitted, and activation permissions are the intersection of lock and conformance observations.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Issuer custody and real reviewer identity enforcement belong to the integrating kernel and Ledger adapter.

lens_traceability.question: Are skill name collisions and shadowing visible?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Collision identities are retained on a BLOCKED_NAME_COLLISION installation and prohibit passing conformance.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: A future installer must enumerate every host-visible catalog and bundled namespace.

lens_traceability.question: Can activation be rolled back and uninstalled cleanly?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Passing conformance requires uninstallVerified and activation records rollbackAvailable.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: S03 accepts a trusted conformance attestation; it does not perform or independently observe uninstall.

lens_traceability.question: Does the malicious-skill fixture suite cover real catalog and packaging variations?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Synthetic hostile variations exercise package hooks, scripts, symlinks, signatures, obfuscation, path collisions, and permission expansion.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No licensed real-catalog corpus or production packaging sample set was available for this package.

lens_traceability.question: Can evidence or model output ever enter the instruction/authority plane?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Runtime-branded evidence and model segments permit data transforms only and all authority requests receive typed denial.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Every future provider and context adapter must route untrusted material through this boundary.

lens_traceability.question: Are secret values represented as handles and excluded from prompts/logs/artifacts?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Opaque handles have no serializable identity and are denied at prompt, artifact, log, export, and ordinary network boundaries.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Raw-secret pattern checks are not exhaustive and trusted adapters must never pass secret bytes into generic payloads.

lens_traceability.question: Are filesystem paths canonicalized with symlink and traversal defenses?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Policy authorization requires canonical in-root portable paths, unchanged root identity, same-device traversal, and no-follow checks.
verification_refs: packages/foundry-kernel/src/security/execution/path-escape.test.mjs#existing symlink or junction components are denied
lens_traceability.residual_limit: The primitive does not perform descriptor-relative atomic effects and cannot eliminate adapter-level TOCTOU risk.

lens_traceability.question: Is network egress allowlisted, metered and receipted?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Exact canonical HTTP(S) origins and per-hop reauthorization are enforced by the observable policy primitive.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Network metering, DNS rebinding defense, transport execution, and effect receipts are not implemented by S02-S04.

lens_traceability.question: Are sandbox boundaries and timeouts enforced independently of model claims?
lens_traceability.current_claim: A model claim cannot change the exact sandbox profile bound into a branded policy decision.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No OS/container sandbox, process timeout, cancellation, or quota is implemented in this phase.

lens_traceability.question: Are tool-hook coverage gaps covered by kernel policy where observable?
lens_traceability.current_claim: Observable path, egress, secret, sandbox-profile, and authority decisions use kernel primitives rather than hook prose.
control_refs: docs/plugin_security_threat_model.md#Hosted tool path not observable: mark coverage gap
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Hosted or specialized paths may be unobservable; absence of a hook event cannot prove enforcement.

lens_traceability.question: Are remote notifications denied raw evidence and arbitrary commands by default?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The master invariant prohibits raw-evidence export and arbitrary command execution by optional remote adapters.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No remote notification or approval adapter exists to test; generic secret filtering is not a substitute for a raw-evidence deny policy.

lens_traceability.question: Are tenancy and workspace boundaries enforced below the UI/model layer?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The canonical work graph assigns database tenancy and cross-workspace retrieval enforcement below presentation layers.
control_refs: manifests/development_manifest.yaml#title: PostgreSQL team store and tenant isolation
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Those storage and recall packages are not implemented at the S04 checkpoint.

lens_traceability.question: Are logs, traces, screenshots and exports redacted under policy?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The execution primitive rejects handles and secret-shaped fields or values at log and export boundaries.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: General PII, licensed-text, trace, and screenshot redaction policies require later observability and UI implementations.

lens_traceability.question: Does a source license constrain downstream export and retention?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The master invariant requires license restrictions to propagate through retrieval, evidence, export, and deletion.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: The corpus registry, retention engine, and export adapter are not implemented at this checkpoint.

lens_traceability.question: Are threat findings linked to tests and non-waivable gates?
lens_traceability.current_claim: All 24 S04-owned lenses and every plugin threat row resolve to controls, tests, limits, and follow-up owners under a drift-detecting gate.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: Traceability proves accounting, not the implementation of explicitly deferred packages.

lens_traceability.question: Does an external security review and penetration test find zero unresolved critical issues?
lens_traceability.current_claim: The S04 author-run adversarial suite found no unresolved critical defect in the implemented S01-S03 boundary scope.
lens_traceability.residual_limit: No independent external penetration test or production host assessment was performed.

threat_traceability.residual_limit: Signal matching is advisory; every future context adapter must preserve origin-based denial.
